Each rule you switch on moves matching records to the Recycle Bin once a day. Records on legal hold are skipped. Closed tickets Delete closed tickets after Years Months Days Between 1 month and 20 years. A year counts as 365 days and a month as 30. Closed tickets are moved to the Recycle Bin 33 days after they were closed, with their conversations and attachments. Finished activities Delete finished activities after Years Months Days Between 1 month and 20 years. A year counts as 365 days and a month as 30. Off. Finished activities are kept until someone deletes them. Contacts and accounts with no tickets Delete them when unchanged
